msContents.summary: Greek-Latin bilingual manuscript; this file transcribes the Gospel of Mark (Latin).

projectDesc.p: This transcription was made for the COMPAUL project.

editorialDecl.p: The initial file was made on the base text of Mark prepared for COMPAUL project by Hugh Houghton
This is a Vulgate base text file with nomina sacra marked
The plain text file was converted to XML by Catherine Smith using the project's Python conversion scripts 1.0.
The XML specifications used were version 1.4 of the IGNTP Guidelines available at
